task.description: Design and add any missing tests/specs required for EXT-03 so all acceptance criteria and edge cases are explicitly covered. Review existing EXT-03 unit tests and add/adjust tests and specs where coverage is incomplete, especially startup-only registration, plugin precedence shadowing built-ins, panic-to-ERROR mapping, COMPLETE/ERROR outcome handling, and EE-09/EE-10 integration behavior. Ensure test spec file for EXT-03 is present and aligned with implemented behavior. Keep tests deterministic and follow test developer guide conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Every EXT-03 MUST/SHOULD acceptance criterion and edge case has at least one test case
A test spec exists and is aligned to implemented behavior
Tests are deterministic and suitable for CI execution
Handoff artifacts include all new/updated specs and test files

result.summary: Created EXT-03 test specification and expanded unit tests to close coverage gaps for startup-only registration, plugin precedence shadowing, COMPLETE/ERROR handling, panic reason mapping, and explicit EE-09/EE-10 integration traceability.
